items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: The jazz guitar of Django Reinhardt ... also helped mold Cal’s eclectic style.

ctx.x: Guitarist Cal Collins was born on May 5, 1933 in Medora, Indiana. His early influences were diverse, from the mandolin styles of local bluegrass groups to the western swing of Bob Wills. The jazz guitar of Django Reinhardt and piano stylings of Art Tatum also helped mold Cal’s eclectic style. His career has included gigs with Benny Goodman, Warren Vache and Scott Hamilton. Cal was interviewed at the Allegheny Jazz Party in Chautauqua, New York on September 11, 1997 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
